Shelf hides folders from your gallery and file manager, then disguises itself as an ordinary app. This takes a minute, and everything here can be changed later.
Shelf randomizes file names and protects headers for fast hiding, not whole files. It stops ordinary browsing and previews, not forensic recovery by someone determined with a computer.

Renaming works everywhere and needs no permission. Root and all-files access hide folders more thoroughly, if this phone offers them.
Optional, and the strongest option without root. It lets Shelf move a folder into hidden storage under a random name, instantly and whatever its size, and it survives uninstalling the app.
Granting this puts “All files access” in Shelf\'s entry in Android\'s permission settings, which is a hint about what the app really does. Without it, folders are hidden by renaming instead.

Learn how to enter undetected, use duress mode, and lock in emergencies.
Shelf masquerades as an everyday app (Calculator, Calendar, or Habits). It carries out genuine calculations, displays real dates, and logs habits so nobody suspects a vault.

• Calculator: Type your PIN or knock sequence and tap “=” directly.
• Double-Tap: Quickly double-tap the title bar in the toolbar.
• Long-Press: Hold the title bar or equals key for 1 second.
• Fake Crash: When enabled, entering shows a fake “App keeps stopping” dialog. Hold the message to slip inside.
Tap any hidden folder to view photos and play full HD videos directly inside the vault. Files are decrypted only in memory and never written to disk, remaining hidden from galleries.
If forced to unlock your phone, enter your Decoy PIN instead of your real PIN. Shelf opens a harmless fake vault with sample folders, keeping your true private files concealed.
Flip your phone face-down on any surface to immediately close the vault and lock down all folders. You can also lock instantly from the notification shade.
Always unhide your folders or export an encrypted recovery backup in Settings before uninstalling the app or switching devices.
For Calculator, Direct Keypad lets you simply enter your PIN and tap “=” without any hidden gestures.
Automatic selects the best and safest hiding engine for your phone. Recommended for all users.
